page.layout: One title page: the printed lines in the upper part, a central engraved vignette, and a short imprint below the engraving. No margin notes.
page.notes: The page is faded and shows show-through from the reverse, so most of the smaller lines between the title and the engraving cannot be read. The engraving in the centre of the page (a framed vignette) is not transcribed. The imprint below it is too faint to read. Readings marked [?] are uncertain. The top line and the line "Deum ... Apologia" are doubtful.
